market.title: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics: Winner?
market.rules_primary: If the Boston Celtics win the New York Knicks vs Boston Celtics game scheduled for Nov 8, 2026, including any overtime, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary: If the game is postponed, the market remains open until the rescheduled game is played. If the game is cancelled, the market resolves per the exchange's cancellation rules.
